renderGapFinding.summary: After the 15 JSX tap-target fixes the source tokens read h-11 w-11 / min-h-11 and the token-based law scanner passed, but rendering still measured 36x36 on persona carousel buttons. A fresh probe div with class h-11 w-11 appended to body measured 44, so the base utility was correct; the defeat was local to the landing control selectors.
renderGapFinding.cause: frontend/src/styles/public-icons.css pins width/height/min-width/min-height of public icon controls to var(--icon-control-size) with !important at ID-level specificity (#main:not(...) :where(section:not(...)) :is(button...)). --icon-control-size was 2.25rem (36px). The !important layer even nullified an inline style height:44px override test (offsetHeight stayed 36).
renderGapFinding.symptomDetail: Element classList contained h-11 w-11 (post-fix), computed height was 35.9971px; cascade dump showed matched rules: (.h-11 -> 2.75rem) BELOW the winning (#main... -> var(--icon-control-size) = 2.25rem) rule.
renderGapFinding.fix: Raised the design-system control size at its single definition point: --icon-control-size: 2.25rem -> 2.75rem (44px) in public-icons.css, and updated its comment to match. Glyph tokens (--icon-control-glyph 1.5rem, --icon-plus 1.25rem) are untouched, so icon art stays 24px in a 44px circle.
renderGapFinding.healsBeyondThe15: The same var drives every public carousel/gallery/story-plus/dialog-close control, so other public pages whose buttons already carried h-11 tokens but rendered 36 are healed by the same change (render-gap class, not visible to a token-based scanner).
renderGapFinding.scannerBlindSpot: qa-continuity's tap-target law reads class tokens in source; CSS --icon-control-size !important overrides are invisible to it. Recorded as the known render-truth gap of this task; future proposal: extend the scanner to (a) collect --icon-control-size from public-icons.css and fail if below 2.75rem, and (b) optional runtime verification pass (already sketched in the dialogue) measuring computed control sizes on rendered pages.
